repositories.verification_scope: The declared python -m pytest -q interop command checks the Python interoperability test suite only. It does not ratify canonical SPEC-004/CPOL behavior, verify all source modules, or establish production deployment.

The python test_sk.py command runs the Safety Kernel CLI, proof-generation, proof-integrity, and tamper-detection checks. It is not formal verification of the host operating system, hardware isolation, or production certification.

The pytest tests suite checks this repository's declared application tests at the recorded commit. It does not establish live-service availability, successful municipal deployments, or production conformance.

Five unit tests exercise the sovereignty-flow gate predicates, including human control/ownership, quality conditions, extraction/power-concentration blocking, and singleton compatibility. They do not validate the complete orchestration platform or production deployment.
CAIOS Interop adapter and AETHEL Interop v1 response contract only; not the full OpenClaw Colony suite, Rust kernel, or production conformance.
The verifier runs the repository's CI-declared interop suite only. Passing it does not establish full-system behavior, every external integration, or production deployment.

Alpha Intelligence Hub scaffold integrity only: checks the declared Compose service/build-context contract, the fail-fast migration script's shell syntax, and well-formed/consistent Git remote declarations. It does not initialize/merge repositories, build target images, execute the referenced services, or establish production conformance.
The verifier runs scripts/test_worldtribe.py contract/sidecar checks. It does not establish a live blockchain deployment, production key management, transaction finality, or external identity trust.
The verifier runs the repository's tests suite at the recorded commit. It does not guarantee live-data freshness, deployment behavior, or production decision safety.

Documentation-contract verification only: checks required design documents and license, truthful disclosure that no executable engine is present, the arithmetic sum of the six proposed evaluation weights, historical roadmap status labeling, and OpenClaw attribution. It does not verify a CALCULA engine, runtime, payment protocol, or empirical/scientific law.

Scaffold and documentation integrity only: checks the files present, accurate disclosure that the executable crew_colony.py runtime and prior claimed suite are absent, arithmetic of the documented 84/15/1 MANNA allocation, and explicit limitations. It does not verify an executable multi-agent runtime or production conformance.

The verifier runs ClawHub's ci:unit unit/coverage command with its locked workspace dependencies. It does not prove every third-party skill is secure, establish publishing integrity, or test every runtime integration.

Concept-document and bill-of-materials integrity only: checks current artifact presence, disclosure that no app/backend/runtime is shipped, concept-area presence, the no-fabricated-pricing statement, and procurement engineering/code-review caveats. It does not validate a deployed application, physical engineering, cost estimates, regulations, or real-world performance.
